QUOTE: "`stale_code_refusal` makes `build_or_refresh` refuse when the process predates its source, and `force=True` does not override that."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the write path refuses (not warns) and that force=True cannot override it, which is the substance of the item. It never says the refusal sits ahead of the build decision, but the force-flag point implies it.
